In this episode, I break down how I’ve used Craigslist for years as a real money-making tool, not just a place to buy random stuff. I walk through how scraping data helped me spot opportunities, connect buyers and sellers, and build businesses that actually worked, including one that eventually turned into a multi-million-dollar exit. I also show how tools like Oxylabs make this way easier today, even if you’re not technical, and how scraped data can be used for flipping, lead generation, arbitrage, and simple side hustles that scale. The big takeaway is learning how to look at old platforms in a new way and turn attention into leverage.

Enjoy!
